scenarios.describes: The list by attention at home: five needs (rota-export decision first), five epic lines with rota-export building and waiting on a decision, two just ended, two new, two working (lamp-telemetry, harvest-report), four seen, host meters footer.

Epic rota-export at moment 0: building 49 min, tz-fixtures paused on a decision with three option cards, red proof 5 failing at base plus 1 review card, orrery with 2 of 7 integrated, Now/Next/Just happened.
Epic holder-scopes released v0.45.0 at 09:52 after 1 h 48 min: all proofs green, three done release step cards, report with four shipped rows, epic review clean.

The unaccepted tide-alerts contract: decision line card with severe care and open counts, three failure rows, one added row to Keep or Drop, seven folded sections, footer with 2 choices left, the Ask-for-a-change box and Accept.
The rota-export contract after acceptance: accepted 13:50 pill, serious care, the added row kept, no footer.

Task export-cli of rota-export opened on its checking phase while round 3 implements: R4 heading and story, four phase rows with checking open (failed gate output, engine check chips, passing gate, test evidence), Hold and Stop buttons, 4:12 timer.

The implementer session of export-cli: brief fold, tool groups, a failed round-1 return card with check chips, round-2 return, review finding F1, a live Bash call, assistant prose and the nudge composer.
The Talk dock open beside epic rota-export on session rota-planning: header with the epic link chip, context chip, one you message, one epic_get tool row, one reply, composer.
Epic rota-export with the Talk menu open (press t after load; no hash opens it): rota-planning, lamp-telemetry and + New session in ~/code/lighthouse.

Session lamp-telemetry working with a Bash call running: compaction, a 6-call tool group, prose with a code block, a you message from the phone, the since-you-looked rule, two single calls, a streaming line, two queued messages and the composer at context 15%.
Session beacon-schedule waiting on its question Which index should I add?, with three options (Composite index, Partial index, Something else).
